Script.name: GUI Lifecycle
Script.script:
-- ============================================================================= -- ENTRY POINT HANDLERS -- These ensure GUI.initializeOrRefresh is called at the right times -- while preserving other initialization functions -- =============================================================================
-- The onProtocolEnabled handler is defined in the MSDP script section -- It handles MSDP variable registration and GUI initialization
-- The main initialization handlers are registered at the bottom of this script -- along with the original GUI.init() registration to ensure proper order
local function runLifecycleStep(scope, callable) if type(callable) ~= "function" then GUI.debugError("LIFECYCLE/" .. scope, "required function is unavailable") return false end local ok, result = pcall(callable) if not ok then GUI.debugError("LIFECYCLE/" .. scope, result) end return ok, result end
local function prepareLoadedState() runLifecycleStep("load preferences", GUI.loadToggles) runLifecycleStep( "initialize layout profiles", GUI.AdjustableContainers and GUI.AdjustableContainers.init ) runLifecycleStep("apply preferences", GUI.applyPreferencesAfterLoad) end
-- Since Mudlet 4.20, sysLoadEvent passes a boolean: true for a fresh profile -- load, false when it fires after resetProfile(). That distinction matters: -- after a resetProfile() the connection is usually still up and MSDP was -- already negotiated, so sysProtocolEnabled will NOT fire again and the GUI -- would otherwise sit empty, never having sent its REPORT subscriptions. function GUI.onSysLoadEvent(_, isNewLoad) GUI.debug("LIFECYCLE", "sysLoadEvent fired", { isNewLoad = isNewLoad, initializedBefore = GUI.initialized, }) prepareLoadedState() GUI.init() if type(GUI.debugSnapshot) == "function" then GUI.debugCall( "SNAPSHOT/sysLoad immediate", GUI.debugSnapshot, "sysLoadEvent immediate" ) GUI.setOwnedTimer("lifecycle.loadSnapshot", 2, GUI.debugWrap("LIFECYCLE/sysLoad delayed snapshot", function() GUI.debugCall( "SNAPSHOT/sysLoad delayed", GUI.debugSnapshot, "sysLoadEvent plus two seconds" ) end)) end
-- isNewLoad == false means we came from resetProfile(). Older Mudlet -- versions pass nil here, so only take this path on an explicit false. if isNewLoad == false then GUI.setOwnedTimer("lifecycle.profileReset", 0.5, GUI.debugWrap("LIFECYCLE/profile reset recovery", function() if map and map.initialize then local ok, initialized = GUI.debugCall( "LIFECYCLE/profile reset/map.initialize", map.initialize ) if not ok or initialized == false then print("[GUI] Mapper initialization failed after profile reset: " .. tostring(initialized)) end else print("[GUI] Mapper initialization is unavailable after profile reset") end if GUI.requestMSDPReports() then print("[GUI] Re-subscribed to MSDP after profile reset") end GUI.initializeOrRefresh("profile reset") end)) end end
function GUI.onSysInstallEvent(_, packageName) if packageName ~= "LuminariGUI" then return end GUI.debug("LIFECYCLE", "LuminariGUI sysInstall fired") prepareLoadedState() GUI.init() end
function GUI.onConnectionEvent(...) GUI.debug("LIFECYCLE", "sysConnectionEvent fired", {...}) GUI.setOwnedTimer("lifecycle.connectionRefresh", 1, GUI.debugWrap("LIFECYCLE/connection refresh timer", function() GUI.initializeOrRefresh("connection established") if type(GUI.debugSnapshot) == "function" then GUI.debugCall( "SNAPSHOT/connection", GUI.debugSnapshot, "one second after connection" ) end end)) end
function GUI.onExitEvent() runLifecycleStep("profile exit cleanup", GUI.cleanup) end
function GUI.onUninstallPackage(_, packageName) if packageName ~= "LuminariGUI" then return end local ok, cleaned = runLifecycleStep( "package uninstall cleanup", GUI.cleanupPackageResources ) if ok then GUI.debug("LIFECYCLE", "package resources removed", cleaned) end end
-- Keep lifecycle registration idempotent when scripts are recompiled or a -- fixed release is upgraded again in the same Mudlet session. The legacy -- anonymous closures from pre-split releases did not expose IDs; the guarded -- GUI entry points above coalesce their one unavoidable migration overlap. GUI.lifecycleHandlerIds = GUI.lifecycleHandlerIds or {} GUI.LIFECYCLE_HANDLERS = { ["sysLoadEvent"] = "GUI.onSysLoadEvent", ["sysInstall"] = "GUI.onSysInstallEvent", ["sysProtocolEnabled"] = "GUI.onProtocolEnabled", ["sysConnectionEvent"] = "GUI.onConnectionEvent", ["sysExitEvent"] = "GUI.onExitEvent", ["sysUninstallPackage"] = "GUI.onUninstallPackage", }
function GUI.unregisterLifecycleHandlers() return GUI.unregisterOwnedHandlers( GUI.lifecycleHandlerIds, GUI.LIFECYCLE_HANDLERS ) end
local function registerLifecycleHandler(event, handler) local handlerId, handlerError = GUI.registerOwnedHandler( GUI.lifecycleHandlerIds, event, event, handler, "LIFECYCLE/" .. event ) if not handlerId then GUI.debugError( "LIFECYCLE/register/" .. event, "failed to register " .. tostring(handler) .. ": " .. tostring(handlerError) ) end return handlerId end
registerLifecycleHandler("sysLoadEvent", "GUI.onSysLoadEvent") registerLifecycleHandler("sysInstall", "GUI.onSysInstallEvent")
-- Register protocol handler early to ensure it catches MSDP enablement -- This is critical because MSDP can be enabled before GUI.init() completes registerLifecycleHandler("sysProtocolEnabled", "GUI.onProtocolEnabled")
-- Add connection-based refresh registerLifecycleHandler("sysConnectionEvent", "GUI.onConnectionEvent") registerLifecycleHandler("sysExitEvent", "GUI.onExitEvent") registerLifecycleHandler("sysUninstallPackage", "GUI.onUninstallPackage")
